Respondent Counsel for the Petitioner : Mr.Siva Prasad Reddy Venati Counsel for the Respondent : The Assistant Public Prosecutor ORDER:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
2. The present petition is filed seeking to quash the proceedings in P.R.C.No.57 of 2018 on the file of the Learned Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kandukur, Prakasam District.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kandukur, Prakasam District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner herein is Accused No.3 in the said case, which was registered for the offences punishable under Sections 307, 420, 272, 275, 120-B and 353 of IPC and Sections 30(2)(1), 58, 59 and 62 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

4. At the time of considering the matter, it is submitted that the matter is covered by an Order dated 27.08.2018 passed in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 in so far as the offences registered under Sections 272,
273 and 328 IPC and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
5. Perused the said order and as the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is not disputed, this Court is inclined to dispose of the present Criminal Petition.

Accordingly and for the reasons alike, the Criminal Petition is partly allowed by quashing the proceedings registered against Vemula Srinivasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 30 August, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173743819/
